It is not a medical diagnosis. Evaluation Evidence Reviewed [X] Psychoeducational Evaluation - 2024-10-15 [X] Academic Evaluation - 2024-10-18 [X] Speech-Language Evaluation - 2024-10-22 Summary of Relevant Evidence Teacher information documents a persistent classroom reading fluency concern. Academic evaluation results include oral reading fluency of 42 WCPM and oral reading accuracy of 86%. Reading comprehension during grade-level text tasks is below expected classroom level. Connected-text reading is slow and effortful, with frequent pauses. Psychoeducational evidence indicates general reasoning and cognitive functioning are broadly within the expected range for age. A global cognitive limitation is not identified as the primary explanation. No separate speech-language educational need is identified from this evaluation.
